from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import subprocess

manifest = json.loads(Path('/tmp/astra-pass95-inputs.json').read_text())
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for path, expected in manifest['hashes'].items():
    assert digest(path) == expected, path
document_count = 0
for document in manifest['binding_documents']:
    for path, expected in re.findall(r'\| `([^`]+)` \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|', Path(document).read_text()):
        assert digest(path) == expected, (document, path)
        document_count += 1
receipt = json.loads(Path('research/astra-strict-core-implementation.json').read_text())
assert digest(receipt['source']['path']) == receipt['source']['sha256_final']
for binding in receipt['input_bindings'].values():
    assert digest(binding['path']) == binding['sha256']
attempts = receipt['verification']['attempts']
assert [a['exit_status'] for a in attempts] == [1, 1, 0]
assert attempts[-1]['source_sha256'] == receipt['source']['sha256_final']
history = json.loads(Path('research/astra-strict-core-failure-sources.json').read_text())
for snapshot, attempt in zip(history['failed_attempt_sources'].values(), attempts[:2], strict=True):
    assert hashlib.sha256(snapshot['source_text'].encode()).hexdigest() == attempt['source_sha256']
probe = receipt['verification']['axiom_probe']
assert probe['exit_status'] == 0
required = {'LonelyRunner.strict_core_bound_of_global_minimum',
            'LonelyRunner.not_complementSafe_of_global_maximum'}
reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^]]*)\]", probe['combined_stdout_stderr_raw'])
assert {name for name, _ in reports} == required and len(reports) == 2
for name, axioms in reports:
    assert set(axioms.split(', ')) <= {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}, name
assert probe['source_text'].splitlines()[0] == 'import LonelyRunner.StrictCoreContraction'
for command in [receipt['verification']['compile_argv'], probe['argv']]:
    for fragment in ['MemoryMax=4G', 'MemorySwapMax=512M', 'TasksMax=128',
                     'flock -n .lake/verification.lock', 'lean -j1']:
        assert fragment in command, fragment
def load_module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module
trust = load_module('trust', 'scripts/audit_lean_trust.py')
sources = [Path('LonelyRunner.lean'), *sorted(Path('LonelyRunner').rglob('*.lean'))]
for source in sources:
    assert not trust.source_has_forbidden_constructs(source.read_text()), source
assert 'import LonelyRunner.StrictCoreContraction' in Path('LonelyRunner.lean').read_text().splitlines()
audit = Path('LonelyRunner/AxiomAudit.lean').read_text().splitlines()
tree = ast.parse(Path('scripts/audit_lean_trust.py').read_text())
sets = [ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
        and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'required_probes' for t in n.targets)]
assert len(sets) == 1 and required <= sets[0]
for name in required:
    assert audit.count('#print axioms ' + name) == 1
delegation = load_module('delegation', 'scripts/report_delegation.py')
metrics = json.loads(Path('research/astra-terra-high-deliveries-30.json').read_text())
assert digest('scripts/report_delegation.py') == metrics['report_script_sha256']
assert delegation.summarize(metrics['input_metric_snapshot']) == metrics['full_report']
assert metrics['full_report']['closed_count'] == 30
assert metrics['latest_ten'] == delegation.summarize({
    'active_tasks': [], 'completed_tasks': metrics['input_metric_snapshot']['completed_tasks'][-10:]})
live_report = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', 'scripts/report_delegation.py', '--json'],
                            text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
assert json.loads(live_report.stdout) == metrics['full_report']
subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], check=True)
for path in manifest['new_text_files']:
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    assert text.endswith('\n'), path
    assert not re.search(r'[ \t]+$', text, re.M), path
print(json.dumps({'frozen_hashes': len(manifest['hashes']),
                  'document_bindings': document_count,
                  'lean_sources_scanned': len(sources),
                  'required_new_axiom_probes': len(required),
                  'failed_sources_recovered': 2,
                  'terra_high_deliveries_reproduced': 30,
                  'scope': 'Local source, receipt and integration checks. Full hosted build pending; unrestricted LRC unresolved.'}, indent=2))
